Settings

Live Data — FMP API Key

Paste your Financial Modeling Prep API key to pull live data directly — no Claude required. Stored only in this browser (not shared, not committed to your repo). Get a key free at financialmodelingprep.com → Dashboard → API Keys.
Auto-refresh:
Free FMP tier is ~250 calls/day — pick a slower refresh (or "on open only") unless you have a paid plan.

Vision — Anthropic API Key

Lets the composer read price levels off your chart screenshots. Stored only in this browser — never shared, never committed. Get a key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys. Reads cost a few cents each.
Vision model:

Funded Account

Switches on target progress, drawdown headroom and daily-limit breach warnings in the weekly review. Needs Risk $ logged on your trades to compute dollars. Leave blank to hide.

Live Account — TopstepX

Powers the Live tab: real-time quotes, key levels, SMT, account governor and positions. Read-only — no orders are ever placed. Key stored only in this browser.
✕

Compose Framework

Your full pre-market in one place — readiness, bias, levels, liquidity target, execution framework and charts. Saves to your Daily Briefings calendar and drives the Pre Market Framework panel in Trade Ideas.

Readiness — your state before the session · 1 poor → 5 excellent

Pre Market Report — before 09:30 · Draw → POI → SMT, pre-loaded in advance

Time and CSD align live in the Master Sequence Card once 09:30 hits. No stacked POI in line with the Draw = nothing to prep. We wait.

Session Read

Chart Screenshots

The coach reads these charts through your Execution Protocol Framework and writes the Price Read. Needs an Anthropic key (Settings ⚙).
PNG or JPG only. HEIC screenshots (iPhone / Continuity) cannot be read — on Mac open in Preview → File → Export → JPEG, or set Screenshot to PNG.
